name: Putt Putt
description:
**Goal:** clear all seven tableau columns onto the foundation.

- Play the **top card** of any column onto the foundation if it is one rank **up or down** from the foundation's top card (no suit restriction).
- Rank **wraps**: an Ace and a King are adjacent, so either can follow the other.
- With **Jokers** on, the two Jokers are **wild**: a Joker plays on any card, and any card plays on a Joker.
- Draw the **stock** onto the foundation to keep going (one pass only — no recycling).
- Stuck with no legal move and an empty stock? The game is **lost**.
- Your **score** is the number of cards left in the tableau, lower is better. Clear the tableau and each card left in the stock takes one off.
